text:
morgan: Heads up — two flaky A100s in eu-west-1 cluster-12. Seen repeated ECC flaps then Xid65, intermittent hangs.
morgan: Serials: GPU-SN-AX12-9987, GPU-SN-AX12-9988 (both on node gpu-12-03). Logs attached to the vendor ticket I'm opening.
shiv: okay — opening vendor ticket now. I'll include NVML dumps, kernel oops and power rails snapshot. link: https://vendor.example.com/tickets/RED-4872
alex: thanks. Can we soft-RMA these? Customer wants minimal downtime — prefer depot swap (field pickup) and swap-in spares rather than full RMA manifest if possible.
riley: EU customs window: local depot can do same-day pickup until 16:00 CET, after that next-day. Need CN22 + invoice on package for crossdock.
kartik: I can coordinate courier (local partner) for field pickup :truck: — ETA 4hrs if we dispatch now. Do we have spare serials ready to ship?
alex: spare pool has GPU-SN-SP-3001 and GPU-SN-SP-3002 in DUB depot. They'll fit the node and are pre-burned with runtime image.
morgan: perfect. Plan: drain node, swap cards in rack, courier picks failed cards to depot, vendor processes RMA from depot. Who will drain and verify KV cache flush?
shiv: i'll run drain script and verify under 10m. Command: ```./drain-node --node gpu-12-03 --force-evict --kv-flush``` I'll post results here when done.
ops-bot: [automation] scheduled maintenance window at 2026-03-18T13:30:00Z for gpu-12-03. Notifying affected routes.
morgan: Drain started. Shiv, ping when done and paste drain output.
shiv: drain finished — no in-flight requests remain. KV flush ok. snippet: "evicted 12 sessions, kv-cache cleared, pod reschedule started" :thumbsup:
alex: swap team on-site now. kartik, courier ETA 3.5h. Riley please prepare customs docs and attach to ticket.
riley: Uploaded manifest + commercial invoice to ticket: https://vendor.example.com/tickets/RED-4872/files/manifest.csv
kartik: courier dispatched, pickup reference C12345. I'll update tracking in ticket.
morgan: After swap, run smoke test on model-serving route and confirm latency/throughput. If degraded, fallback to model-variant small until we validate.
shiv: smoke tests green — p50/p99 within baseline. Reconciled serials in inventory sheet: https://internal.example.com/sheets/gpu-serials
alex: vendor asked for power-on logs from returned cards. Kartik — ensure depot packs include power cycle logs and original node assignment.
kartik: noted — will attach logs and sign off on custody form at depot. Also flagged for expedited replacement due to customer SLA.
morgan: Closing loop: ticket RED-4872 updated with action notes, spare serials used, courier ref. If vendor confirms replacement SNs, we'll mark failed SNs as embargoed and schedule warranty follow-through.
ops-bot: [incident-tracker] thread linked to INC-2026-113 for long-term trend monitoring (ECC flaps region: eu-west-1).
alex: small follow-up — add these GPUs to flaky watchlist and increase polling to 1m for next 48h.
morgan: done. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
_meta: generated for dataset: rma and replacement logistics, unique thread focusing on field pickup / soft-RMA swap and courier handoff
